# LocalCreators

> LocalCreators is an Australian self-serve platform where small businesses post briefs and set their own budget per brief, and local nano creators (1,000–10,000 followers) apply to post about them. Launching soon in Sydney, Australia.

## What it is

- A small business (cafe, salon, gym, boutique, restaurant) pays a monthly subscription — Starter $29/month, Growth $49/month, Multi-location $99/month — and posts briefs with a budget it sets, from a $50 minimum per brief.
- Creators see transparent rates upfront, submit finished content, and are only paid when the business approves the post — payment is held in escrow until approval. A 10% platform fee applies to approved brief budgets only.
- Matching is suburb-level: creators are verified as local by where their audience lives, not just where the creator lives.
- Weekly suburb leaderboards and brief contests rank creators by local views, in the style of Posted's contests — without Posted's $500/month subscription and $5,000 contest minimum.
- Automatic disclosure compliance is built in for Australian advertising rules.

## Why local nano creators

- Nano creators (1K–10K followers) have a median engagement rate of 2.1%, versus 0.5% for mega creators (Virev 2026 study of 391,731 Instagram creators).
- Median sponsored post cost: $110 for nano creators versus $636 for micro creators (Virev 2026).
- For comparison, Posted charges $500/month with a $5,000 contest minimum (Posted help centre, October 2026).
- Australia has 2,656,469 small businesses (ABS, June 2025).
